task_description: Replace the existing Kotlin/Neo4j starter project with a complete full-stack family tree management application using Node.js/Express + SQLite backend and React/TypeScript + React Flow frontend. The app supports adding/editing people and relations, viewing people in a table with detail views, and visualizing the family tree as an interactive graph showing ancestors and descendants.

verification.summary: All 7 review issues fixed. Server builds and all 28 tests pass (24 original + 4 new for validation/dedup). Client builds successfully. Semantic review v2 APPROVED. Non-blocking notes: with-person endpoint skips validation (only exploitable via direct API), directional duplicate check (tree rendering handles gracefully), update allows empty names.
